parameters.name: FrontendPort
parameters.description: The forward port to query. Valid values: **0** to **65535**.

parameters.name: FrontendProtocol
parameters.description:
The Forwarding Protocol type to query. Valid values:

- **tcp**: TCP protocol.
- **udp**: UDP protocol.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance to query.

> You can invoke [DescribeInstanceIds](~~157459~~) to query the IDs of all Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instances.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number to return in a paged query. For example, set this parameter to **1** to return the first page of results.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of records on each page in a paged query.
